item.title: Broadcasting group thanks Maui listeners following repairs from storm impacts - Pacific Media Group
item.description: The aftermath of a kona low storm in December had extended impacts on Maui where Pacific Media Group operates a network of radio stations and other digital media products.

item.title: Pacific Media Group Celebrates Midpoint of Hawaii’s Finest Talent Contest with Exciting Lineup and Amazing Performances - Pacific Media Group
item.description: Pacific Media Group is thrilled to announce the exciting midpoint of Hawaii’s Finest Talent Contest, marking a pivotal moment in this statewide search for Hawaii’s next musical sensation.

item.title: KPOA's Shane Kahalehau wins Nā Hōkū Hanohano award for 2024 Most Promising Artist of the Year - Pacific Media Group
item.description: Longtime musician and on-air Maui radio personality, Shane Kaonohiokalā Kahalehau, was recognized by the Hawaiʻi Academy of Recording Arts with the 2024 Nā Hōkū Hanohano award for Most Promising Artist of the Year.

item.title: Pacific Media Group Job Fair: Thursday, Oct. 17, 2024 at QKC - Pacific Media Group
item.description: Pacific Media Group will be hosting a Job Fair on Thursday, Oct. 17 from 11 a.m. to 2 p.m. at the Queen Kaʻahumanu Center in Kahului. There will be nearly 45 businesses and departments looking to hire.

item.title: Pacific Media Group welcomes Tammy Mencel as Oʻahu Radio General Manager - Pacific Media Group
item.description: HONOLULU, OʻAHU – Tammy Mencel has joined Pacific Media Group (PMG) as the company’s new General Manager of Honolulu Radio Operations. Mencel is a resident of Oʻahu, calling Hawaiʻi Kai home for the past 10 years.
